name: renderer
title: Renderer
summary: Yea's 3D rendering engine to drop into a view: PBR materials, a coloured sun, point and spot lights, light culling in compute, cascaded and cached local shadows, ambient occlusion, contact shadows, reflection probes, dynamic global illumination, ray-traced and screen-space reflections, variable-rate shading, a physical sky and atmosphere, volumetric fog, GPU particles, sorted glass and see-through surfaces, clustered decals, temporal antialiasing, FSR and DLSS upscaling, auto exposure and tonemapping, with every part tunable in F1.
